source_evidence: You pay no taxes on any interest or investment gains in your annuity until you withdraw the money, receive income payments, or a death benefit is paid.
answer: Tax-deferred growth means that interest or investment gains in an annuity are not taxed while they remain in the annuity. Taxes may apply when you withdraw money, receive income payments, or a death benefit is paid. For a deferred annuity, the period when money can grow before income payments begin is called the accumulation phase.
